chunks: Sahl, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musanna, from Abu Hatim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the man who divorces his wife with the divorce by which she becomes permissible to him only after marrying another husband. Then another man married her but did not consummate the marriage with her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'No, [she is not permissible to the first husband] until he tastes her honey.'

key_terms.يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَهَا: He tastes her honey (idiom for consummation)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a divorced woman to return to her first husband after marrying a second man?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the distinction between *Tahleel* (return after a new marriage) and *Talaq al-Mughallazah* (irrevocable triple divorce) by emphasizing consummation (*Dukhul*) as the decisive factor. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes that a mere contractual marriage without sexual intercourse does not sever the bond sufficiently to allow the first husband to remarry her directly, preserving the integrity of the 'new contract' requirement.
